title: Targeted Active Learning for Preference-Based Treatment Effects on Multivariate Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2610.03824v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Treatment efficacy is traditionally demonstrated on the basis of a single primary outcome. However, clinical decision-making usually requires consideration of multiple outcomes, balancing expected benefits against potential risks. The relative value assigned to these outcomes varies substantially from one patient to another. Given a preference rule over outcome profiles, treatment effects and optimal policies can be defined and estimated. Such a rule is rarely available in practice: it must itself be estimated from pairwise comparisons of outcome profiles, which are costly to collect from clinical experts. We propose an active learning framework that selects which comparisons to query. Standard criteria maximize the information gained on the preference rule itself. We instead target the quantities of interest, and select the query that most reduces uncertainty on the treatment effect and on the optimal policy induced by the learned r

translated_title: 面向多变量结局的基于偏好的治疗效应的定向主动学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.03824v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：治疗疗效传统上是以单一主要结局为依据来验证的。然而，临床决策通常需要综合考虑多个结局，在预期获益与潜在风险之间进行权衡。而不同患者对这些结局赋予的相对价值差异很大。在给定关于结局组合的偏好规则的情况下，可以定义并估计治疗效应和最优策略。但这样的规则在实践中很少现成可用：它本身必须通过结局组合的两两比较来估计，而从临床专家处收集此类比较的成本高昂。我们提出了一个主动学习框架，用于选择向专家查询哪些比较。标准的准则最大化的是对偏好规则本身所获得的信息量。我们则转而以目标量为导向，选择最能降低由所学规则导出的治疗效应和最优策略不确定性的查询……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种定向主动学习框架，通过从临床专家处选择性查询最有信息量的结局组合两两比较，来最大程度降低基于偏好的治疗效应与最优策略估计中的不确定性，而非仅仅最大化对偏好规则本身的信息增益。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a targeted active learning framework that selectively queries the most informative pairwise comparisons of outcome profiles from clinical experts to maximally reduce uncertainty in preference-based treatment effect and optimal policy estimation, rather than merely maximizing information gain on the preference rule itself.
